open_points.subject: plan_run mapped-node conclusion when the map_over list is not delivered
open_points.text: a mapped node whose list has not been delivered has no element, has not concluded and is not ready
open_points.other_text: a skipped_by_guard or upstream_failed record, which runs writes only for a node none of whose elements executed, concludes the whole node so at once, mapped or not — the rule that a mapped node concludes only when every element concluded is for a node whose elements execute —, a function node and an operation node alike — for an operation element through the ElementFailed with that status operation_element_conclusion answers, as said above: skipped_by_guard concludes the node skipped and upstream_failed concludes it upstream_failed
open_points.question: Must the first passage be limited to a list that has not yet been delivered but can still be delivered, or should mapped nodes whose list can no longer be delivered remain unconcluded instead of concluding skipped_by_guard or upstream_failed?
